thread:
marta: Heads up — onboarding failures in eu-west-1 since ~07:30 UTC. New firewall rule dropped privatelink traffic to keystore proxy. GPU nodes stuck in Pending for minutes. Logs show KMS decrypt errors too.

marta: Error excerpt from kube events: `MountVolume.SetUp failed for volume "keystore-creds": rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = kms:Decrypt failed`

devon: :rotating_light: seeing the same. Warm pool tried to spin up 12 nodes, 9 errored. GC activity spikes.

anika: Which firewall change rolled? Was this the egress tightening from last night?@liam?

liam: Yep, security pushed a tighter outbound denylist to reduce data exfil. Rule ID fw-eu-2147 configured at 06:58 UTC. It blocks traffic to non-approved privatelink endpoints by default. We forgot to include the keystore proxy subnet. Sorry — my bad.

marta: Can we temporarily allow keystore hostnames/subnet? Onboarding blocked means customers hit cold-start failures. Cost is compounding because warm pool retries.

sara: Workaround: patching node user-data to use fallback KEYSERVICE via NAT will bypass privatelink but adds egress costs and increases exposure. Not ideal.

anika: We should avoid NAT route unless short-term. Also discovered audit-logging for keystore in eu was toggled to sampling=0. Not great for postmortem.

devon: Steps I recommend: 1) revert fw-eu-2147 to previous policy (quick), 2) add explicit allow for keystore privatelink subnets (longer-term), 3) re-enable keystore audit sampling, 4) requeue failed nodes after vault decrypts. Anyone can take 1?

liam: I'm on 1 and 2. Rolling back now via the firewall console. 

ops-bot: (automated) rollback initiated by liam at 07:58:12 UTC. Change ID ch-98321.

marta: After rollback, I see successful handshakes to keystore from new nodes. KMS decrypt errors drop. Will monitor next 10 mins.

raj: Cost note — if we let nodes fallback to NAT for more than ~30m we'll incur an estimated $3.2/hr extra egress for the warm pool. Also NAT path increases latency for decrypts ~50–70ms.

anika: Logged for audit: please capture who approved the firewall change and why privatelink exceptions weren't included. We need PR + risk assessment in ticket INFRA-6082.

devon: Created INFRA-6082 and added timeline + logs. Also added an immediate runbook update: add keystore privatelink CIDR to allowed list before any egress policy rollouts.

sara: Requeue done for 9 nodes, 7 Joined, 2 still failing with `keystore: access denied`. Investigating IAM role-boundary propagation.

marta: Looks like role-boundary change from last week hadn't propagated to the eu keystore role. That combined with fw change was the multiplier.

liam: Note to self: add preflight check to policy rollout — keystore endpoint probe + IAM role check. Will file a PR for the pipeline.

anika: We should also update the compliance log: re-enable full keystore audit for eu for 72h to capture any anomalies.

devon: Monitoring green for now. Warm pool back to expected capacity. Adding postmortem slot for tomorrow. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
